bibl.title: A Clay Gladius Scabbard from Area 13c in the Ancient Roman Town of Syene.
bibl.seg: Mariola Hepa, A Clay Gladius Scabbard from Area 13c in the Ancient Roman Town of Syene.
bibl.note: The miniaturised clay scabbard has features typical for the gladius scabbards known from military camps of the first and early second centuries. The find context of the object from Syene demonstrates that it belonged to a room decoration or was part of a house altar. It was perhaps dedicated as a votive by a soldier.
